title: Open Values Register Coverage Rules
description: Hand-reviewed rules saying which catalogue decisions each public register can supply facts for. Maintainers write them, and the coverage matrix builder applies them; any pair no rule covers stays marked as not yet reviewed.

format.description: Names the file format. Always open-values-register-coverage-rules.

version.description: The version of this format the file follows. Always 1.0.0.

updated.description: The date the rules were last changed, as YYYY-MM-DD.

note.description: A short paragraph on what the rules do and how a missing rule is read.

statusDefinitions.description: The meaning of each coverage status, in a sentence each.

applicable.description: What applicable means: the register's subject clearly covers the decision.

not-applicable.description: What not-applicable means: a reviewed rule says the register cannot supply facts for the decision.

blocked.description: What blocked means: the register applies, but a named prerequisite stops a pass for now.

unmapped.description: What unmapped means: nobody has reviewed the pair yet. It is the default and does not say the register is irrelevant.

registers.description: One rule set per register on the shelf. Every shelf register must have exactly one, and no others are allowed.

realms.description: Matches decisions under any of these top-level taxonomy ids, such as food-and-drink.

fields.description: Matches decisions in any of these fields, the second level of the taxonomy, such as groceries.

families.description: Matches decisions in any of these families, the level below field, such as pet-food.

types.description: Matches decisions whose type is one of these: Products, Services, Organizations, Initiatives or Media.

modes.description: Matches decisions whose mode, how a person comes to have the thing, is one of these, such as buy, rent or hire.

scopes.description: Matches decisions whose taxonomy scope is one of these. Only covered and open decisions are in the matrix.

decisionIds.description: Matches decisions whose taxonomy id is one of these.

cids.description: Matches decisions whose built dataset id (cid) is one of these.

id.description: A lowercase hyphenated id for the selector, unique within its register. The matrix records it as the reason a status was chosen.

priority.description: Which selector wins when more than one matches the same decision, from 1 to 999; higher wins. Two winning selectors at the same priority that disagree stop the build. A hand-verified citation on the shelf counts as priority 1000.

status.description: The status this selector gives every decision it matches: applicable, not-applicable or blocked.

reason.description: Why the status holds for the matched decisions, in a sentence. It is copied into the matrix.

match.description: Which taxonomy decisions this selector covers. A decision must satisfy every key given here, and within one key any listed value will do. Every value must exist in the current taxonomy, and the selector must match at least one decision.

registerId.description: The id of the register these rules are for, from content/registers.json.

default.description: The status a decision gets from this register when no selector matches it.

status.description: Always unmapped, so a pair nobody has reviewed is never reported as not applicable.

reason.description: A sentence saying the pair has not been reviewed yet.

selectors.description: Reviewed rules that give a status to the decisions they match. May be empty.
